title: ExtracaoConcluida
description: The worker's proposal for one ExtracaoPedida: a list of unavailability periods in the format of 06 · Responsible AI Opportunity Assessment (the same as expected.periods in the evaluation dataset). Version 2 (SCRUM-75) replaces the single interval of version 1 (proposedType, proposedStart, proposedEnd), which nothing produced or consumed. The member edits and confirms the periods in escala-api before they count; free text never travels in this event.

periods.description: Zero or more proposed periods. Empty: nothing usable was found (vague text, a message about when the member CAN serve or about someone else, prompt injection, dates in the past or more than 6 months ahead, AI off or failed), and escala-api shows the form.

method.description: MODEL: the language model (ADR 0016). BASELINE: the rule-based parser (SCRUM-99). FALLBACK: no extraction was made (AI off, timeout, invalid output; ADR 0011); periods is then empty.

model.description: Which model or parser produced the periods, e.g. the model name reported by the CLI or the parser version; null for FALLBACK.

endDate.description: Last day, inclusive; not before startDate.

weekdays.description: Only these days within the range (a repeating pattern, e.g. every Sunday). Absent: every day.

startTime.description: Local time in Europe/Lisbon, applied to every day of the period. With endTime; absent: the whole day.

endTime.description: Local time in Europe/Lisbon. Before startTime: the window crosses midnight (e.g. 20:00 to 08:00).
